# WeiYa

WeiYa is a quiet, macOS-inspired theme with light and dark modes and a reading width, typography and line height tuned for comfortable reading. It styles headings, links, lists, callouts, code blocks, tables and sidebars with restrained visuals, using translucent sidebars on desktop and a solid fallback on mobile. Its recorded description states that it relies on Obsidian's semantic CSS variables and loads no remote resources.

![WeiYa screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weiya9511/weiya-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)
